# 廢廢豬韓國代購

廢廢豬（fat fat pig）提供台灣使用者韓國商品代購、代買、代下單與初步台幣估價。

- Homepage: https://korea-quote-0908.vercel.app/
- Bunjang / 번개장터: https://korea-quote-0908.vercel.app/bunjang/
- Naver SmartStore: https://korea-quote-0908.vercel.app/naver-smartstore/
- Musinsa / 무신사: https://korea-quote-0908.vercel.app/musinsa/
- FruitsFamily / 후루츠패밀리: https://korea-quote-0908.vercel.app/fruitsfamily/
- Olive Young / 올리브영: https://korea-quote-0908.vercel.app/olive-young/
- LINE: @fatfatpig_kr
- Official Shopee profile: https://shopee.tw/chenby

Pricing: known product KRW and Korean domestic shipping are converted using the site's current merchant-maintained quote rate; proxy fee tiers apply to the product + known domestic shipping subtotal. Known Korean platform fees are converted separately. Unknown shipping/platform fees are clearly marked and not guessed. Final purchase price requires human confirmation.
